name: Contribution Todo list
description: Adds a per-node contribution todo-list: users create, share, pin, and state-track todos attached to nodes via a block.
project_description:
The Contrib Todo List module provides a collaborative task management system directly integrated into Drupal nodes. It allows content editors and reviewers to create, share, and track todos specific to content items, making content management and review processes more efficient.

 Requirements 
 
 History module 
 Option module 
 
 Features 
 
 Create todos associated with specific nodes and elements within the content 
 Share todos with other contributors 
 Track todo status 
 Language-specific todos for multilingual sites 
 Permission-based access control 
 
 

 Post-Installation 
 
 Enable the module through the Extend page 
 Grant the "Manage todo list" permission to appropriate roles 
 Place the "Contrib todo list" block in your theme's region 
 Visit any node page to start creating todos 
 Back to top
